maria: quick QA a11y note from today's console review: the 'Insights timeline' mini-chart overlay has a strange tab/hover hitbox. keyboard users land on the chart container but Arrow keys do nothing. kevin_p: saw that. reproducible with VoiceOver and NVDA. the SVG is focusable (tabindex=0) but we don't expose any keyboard handlers for data points. jin: current DOM:
. screen readers announce \"chart\" but can't access point details. samira: for screen reader users we should either expose points as buttons or provide a descriptive list via aria-describedby/aria-details toggled on focus. aria-bot: auto-a11y-scan report (insights-timeline-2026-03): failures: 3 (missing keyboard handlers on interactive SVG, focus target too large, no aria-labels on data points). full: https://ci.internal/a11y/1912345670 maria: two proposed approaches: - Declarative: render each data point as a visually identical positioned over SVG with CSS. This makes them keyboard-focusable and announce counts. - Programmatic: keep single chart container, implement ArrowLeft/Right to step through an internal index and update an aria-live region with point details. kevin_p: pros/cons: buttons = simpler for AT but might bloat DOM for dense charts. roving focus + aria-live = lighter DOM but requires robust keyboard handling and tests. jin: also note the focus ring on the chart container is 1px grey on light theme — almost invisible at 2x zoom. WCAG wants visible focus. proposed CSS: ``` .chart:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0B3B82; outline-offset: 3px; } .point:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(11,59,130,0.2); } ``` samira: small addition: when a point is focused we should add aria-pressed on the button or aria-current on the programmatic step so screen readers know it's the active point. and announce a friendly label like \"Peak: 512 requests at 11:42 AM\". maria: acceptance criteria for INS-7441: - keyboard users can navigate between points (either via tab or arrow keys) - screen readers receive a clear announcement for each selected point - focus indicator meets visibility at 2x zoom - performance: adding point buttons should not regress fps on charts with <=200 points aria-bot: created INS-7441, priority P2, linked scan and perf-run, ETA 6d. kevin_p: i'll prototype the roving-index approach first (lighter DOM). will include an opt-in flag to switch to button-per-point for accessibility QA. jin: test matrix: NVDA+Firefox, VoiceOver+Safari, TalkBack+Chrome Android (for mobile charts). also add a Percy snapshot for focused states. samira: tiny copy tweak: aria-live announcement prefix should be \"Chart update: \" not just raw numbers so it reads more naturally in some screen readers. maria: good call. also add a short tooltip on hover for mouse users (title attr isn't sufficient for AT so keep both). kevin_p: pushing a little branch later today. will ping this thread with a short GIF of keyboard stepping. aria-bot: branch pushed and a11y-ci queued. maria: thanks all. please add any odd rotor/VO screenshots to the ticket. closing thread. :white_flower:
